Bug_Title: IJU: TestCase declares a bad suite method (IJU_BAD_SUITE_METHOD)
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the'suite()' method of the 'BadSuiteMethodTest' class. The method is declared as 'public TestSuite suite()' instead of the required 'public static junit.framework.Test suite()' or 'public static junit.framework.TestSuite suite()'.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered when the'showBug' method is called in the test case. This method calls the'suite' method, which is declared incorrectly in the 'BadSuiteMethodTest' class.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results show that the test suite ran successfully without any errors. This indicates that the suite() method in the BadSuiteMethodTest class is not causing any issues during the test execution. Therefore, the bug described (IJU: TestCase declares a bad suite method) is not present in the Java code.
